feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins race for Alaska governor, replaces a Republican
entry.summary: Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state legislator, ran a campaign emphasizing bipartisanship in the the state that usually votes Republican. At 37, he'll be the youngest governor in the state's history.

entry.title: Stuck on the tarmac without information: Travelers share their ground stop experiences
entry.summary: Passengers stuck on airplanes on tarmacs across the country during the FAA ground stop on Friday share their stories.

entry.title: What we know about the FAA nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration took an extraordinary step Friday afternoon by issuing a nationwide ground stop. No planes are taking off at any airport and millions of passengers are stranded.

entry.title: Old tech blamed for the ground stop that caused flight chaos: 'It got overloaded'
entry.summary: The nationwide ground stop that paralyzed the U.S. aviation system on Friday has ended, according to Federal Aviation Administration.

entry.title: The government says it will close a beloved D.C. park Sunday. Will a judge step in?
entry.summary: Federal judge Ana Reyes grilled the government on Friday about its plans for East Potomac Park, and indicated she could order it to remain open despite President Trump's renovation wishes.

entry.title: USMNT head coach Mauricio Pochettino is leaving for Manchester United
entry.summary: Mauricio Pochettino is out as head coach of the U.S. men's national soccer team. Pochettino led the U.S. to the round of 16 at last year's World Cup. He's departing to coach Manchester United.

entry.title: Nvidia's interim CEO inherits risky AI bets and a legal mess
entry.summary: AI expert Gary Marcus breaks down what's at stake for Nvidia and the mess its new CEO has inherited.

entry.title: Investigation into what cause deadly Brooklyn building collapse continues
entry.summary: Investigators are trying to find out what went wrong after an apartment building collapsed into a nearby construction site in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least eight people.

entry.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
entry.summary:
Pete Hegseth was yelled at by a sentinel for poor decorum at Arlington National Cemetery. Now the Secretary of Defense has
given him a medal.

entry.title: Rivers in the sky are raining down on the Pacific Northwest. What are they?
entry.summary: Atmospheric rivers are large bands of water vapor in the sky. They are dumping trillions of gallons of water on Washington and Oregon, just as high tides and winds batter shorelines.
